name: Making images and video with machine learning
gist: Using generative models like diffusion to create or modify images and video, from new content to editing existing photos.
explain: If computer vision traditionally meant extracting information from images, a newer frontier is the opposite: generating images from scratch. Given a description, a model generates a photo that matches it. Given a photo, a model edits it or transforms it. Given an idea, a model produces a video. This requires not just understanding images but learning to create them — to discover the rules of how pixels should combine to form realistic scenes, textures, and objects.

The fundamental challenge is that images are high-dimensional: a modest-size photo has millions of pixel values, and they are not independent. A pixel's color influences its neighbors. Shapes must be coherent. Objects must obey physics and perspective. Textures must be smooth or rough in consistent ways. Learning to generate images means learning these constraints implicitly through data. Early approaches used generative adversarial networks — a game between a generator that creates fake images and a discriminator that tries to spot fakes, so both improve. Recent approaches use diffusion models: start with random noise and gradually refine it into a real image by learning to reverse the process of noise corruption. Both require handling the curse of dimensionality — the space of possible images is so vast that naive approaches fail.

Papers in this subtheme explore different ways to control image generation. Some use text prompts as conditions, so you describe what you want and the model generates it. Others use example images as prompts — 'paint this photo in the style of van Gogh.' Some focus on editing — given an image and a description of a change, modify only the relevant parts. Others generate videos by extending the diffusion framework to the time dimension, predicting how scenes evolve frame by frame. A few use NeRF-like representations (learned 3D models) to generate images from arbitrary viewpoints. The underlying technology matters less than the goal: make it possible for users to create visuals by describing ideas in natural language.

papers.title: Adaptive Domain Shift in Diffusion Models for Cross-Modality Image Translation
papers.contribution: Improved structural fidelity and semantic consistency across medical imaging, remote sensing, and electroluminescence tasks while converging in fewer denoising steps.

papers.title: Arbitrary-Shaped Image Generation via Spherical Neural Field Diffusion
papers.contribution: Enables precise control over spatial attributes while supporting high-quality synthesis across diverse image shapes (perspective, panoramic, fisheye) with improvements over shape-specific baselines.

papers.title: Efficient Degradation-agnostic Image Restoration via Channel-Wise Functional Decomposition and Manifold Regularization
papers.contribution: Achieves state-of-the-art performance with superior efficiency-performance trade-offs, showing strong zero-shot generalization across degradation types.

papers.title: EnvSocial-Diff: A Diffusion-Based Crowd Simulation Model with Environmental Conditioning and Individual-Group Interaction
papers.contribution: Outperforms state-of-the-art on multiple benchmarks, demonstrating importance of explicit environmental conditioning and multi-level social interaction.

papers.title: Geometric Image Editing via Effects-Sensitive In-Context Inpainting with Diffusion Transformers
papers.contribution: Consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods in visual quality, geometric accuracy, and realism on public benchmarks.

papers.title: H2OFlow: Grounding Human-Object Affordances with 3D Generative Models and Dense Diffused Flows
papers.contribution: Generalizes effectively to real-world objects and surpasses prior methods relying on manual annotations in modeling 3D affordances.

papers.title: LiveMoments: Reselected Key Photo Restoration in Live Photos via Reference-guided Diffusion
papers.contribution: LiveMoments significantly improves perceptual quality and fidelity over existing solutions, especially in scenes with fast motion or complex structures.

papers.title: PI-Light: Physics-Inspired Diffusion for Full-Image Relighting

papers.title: Rethinking Expressivity and Degradation-Awareness in Attention for All-in-One Blind Image Restoration
papers.contribution: Proposed primitives improve restoration across synthetic, mixed, underwater, and medical benchmarks with negligible overhead and consistent performance gains.

papers.title: Towards Better Optimization For Listwise Preference in Diffusion Models
papers.contribution: Diffusion-LPO consistently outperforms pairwise DPO on text-to-image, image editing, and personalized preference tasks.

papers.title: What Happens Next? Anticipating Future Motion by Generating Point Trajectories
papers.contribution: Capture scene-wide dynamics and uncertainty more accurately and diversely than prior regressors and generators, showing video generators poorly forecast motion.

papers.title: Analyzing the Training Dynamics of Image Restoration Transformers: A Revisit to Layer Normalization
papers.contribution: i-LN consistently outperforms vanilla LayerNorm across various image restoration tasks.

papers.title: Any-to-Bokeh: Arbitrary-Subject Video Refocusing with Video Diffusion Model
papers.contribution: The approach demonstrates superior temporal coherence, spatial accuracy, and controllability over prior baselines for video bokeh generation.

papers.title: Bend the Basics: Degradation-Aware Deformable Tokenization for All-in-One Image Restoration
papers.contribution: FIT achieves state-of-the-art performance on five standard benchmarks with 30.72 dB average PSNR on five-degradation settings, outperforming recent unified methods by 0.5-1.1 dB.

papers.title: Boosting Monocular Metric Depth Estimation via Bokeh Rendering
papers.contribution: Superior visual bokeh fidelity compared to depth-dependent rendering; consistently enhances metric accuracy of state-of-the-art monocular depth models.

papers.title: CLEAR: Context-Aware Learning with End-to-End Mask-Free Inference for Adaptive Video Subtitle Removal
papers.contribution: CLEAR achieves superior multilingual subtitle removal requiring only 0.77% trainable parameters with true mask-free end-to-end inference.

papers.title: CRAG: Can 3D Generative Models Help 3D Assembly?
papers.contribution: State-of-the-art performance on in-the-wild objects with diverse geometries, varying part counts, and missing pieces; synthesizes complete shapes.

papers.title: CoCoDiff: Correspondence-Consistent Diffusion Model for Fine-grained Style Transfer
papers.contribution: CoCoDiff delivers state-of-the-art visual quality without additional training or supervision, outperforming methods requiring extra training or annotations.

papers.title: Consistency Geodesic Bridge: Image Restoration with Pretrained Diffusion Models
papers.contribution: Achieves state-of-the-art across image restoration tasks with high-quality recovery using single or fewer sampling steps.

papers.title: Contrastive Diffusion Guidance for Spatial Inverse Problems
papers.contribution: Produces more consistent floorplans from trajectories and is more robust than differentiable-planner baselines and guided-diffusion methods.

papers.title: Cross-Timestep: 3D Diffusion Model with Trans-temporal Memory LSTM and Adaptive Priori Decoding Strategy for Medical Segmentation
papers.contribution: Performs favorably on heterogeneous 3D medical datasets, effectively prevents initial-stage collapse, and facilitates scalability of diffusion models.

papers.title: Degradation-Aware Metric Prompting for Hyperspectral Image Restoration
papers.contribution: Achieves state-of-the-art performance on natural and remote sensing datasets with exceptional zero-shot generalization to unseen restoration tasks.

papers.title: DiffPBR: Point-Based Rendering via Spatial-Aware Residual Diffusion
papers.contribution: DiffPBR improves rendered image quality by 3-5dB, reduces training time from 41 to 8 GPU hours, and increases rendering speed to 10fps.

papers.title: Difference-Aware Decision Learning for Multimodal Image Fusion
papers.contribution: Demonstrates stable and competitive performance against state-of-the-art methods on multiple fusion tasks with uncertainty modulation for conservative mixing under insufficient evidence.

papers.title: Diffuse to Detect: Bi-Level Sample Rebalancing with Pseudo-Label Diffusion for Point-Supervised Infrared Small-Target Detection
papers.contribution: The approach achieves five-fold annotation acceleration and comparable performance with 30% of training data.

papers.title: Expandable, Compressible, Mineable: Open-World Thermal Infrared Image Restoration
papers.contribution: Achieves superior performance across diverse single and compound degradations while using fewer parameters and lower computational cost.

papers.title: Flash-GRPO: Efficient Alignment for Video Diffusion via One-Step Policy Optimization
papers.contribution: 3B to 14B parameter models validate Flash-GRPO's effectiveness, demonstrating substantial training acceleration with consistent stability and state-of-the-art alignment quality

papers.title: From 2D Grids to 1D Tokens: Reforming Shared Representations for Multimodal Image Fusion
papers.contribution: Achieves best overall performance on four benchmarks with consistent multi-metric improvements in both global coherence and local fidelity.

papers.title: FullPart: Generating each 3D Part at Full Resolution
papers.contribution: FullPart achieves state-of-the-art results in 3D part generation, supported by PartVerse-XL, the largest human-annotated 3D part dataset.

papers.title: Fully Zero-Shot Image Dehazing
papers.contribution: Remarkably generalizes across various real-world hazy datasets without any hazy training images.

papers.title: Geometric Reciprocity: Unlocking Self-Supervision for Stereoscopic Video Generation
papers.contribution: First self-supervised framework for monocular-to-stereo conversion achieving improvements over training-free and supervised state-of-the-art methods.

papers.title: ImmersePro: End-to-End Stereo Video Synthesis Via Implicit Disparity Learning
papers.contribution: ImmersePro improves stereo-from-mono baselines by 11.76% (L1), 6.39% (SSIM), and 5.10% (PSNR) on diverse video sequences.

papers.title: Improved Object-Centric Diffusion Learning with Registers and Contrastive Alignment
papers.contribution: CODA improves object discovery by 6.1% FG-ARI on COCO over strong baselines and enables robust object-centric learning in complex real-world scenes.

papers.title: Improving 2D Diffusion Models for 3D Medical Imaging with Inter‑Slice Consistent Stochasticity
papers.contribution: ISCS is plug-and-play and can be integrated into any 2D-trained diffusion pipeline without additional computational cost.

papers.title: InfVSR: Toward Consistency-Driven Streaming Generative Video Super-Resolution
papers.contribution: InfVSR achieves state-of-the-art quality with enhanced semantic consistency and up to 58x speedup for long-form video sequences.

papers.title: Joint Shadow Generation and Relighting via Light-Geometry Interaction Maps
papers.contribution: Significant gains in realism and consistency across synthetic and real images by enabling physics-inspired priors that constrain generative models and bridge geometry-inspired rendering.

papers.title: LSGQuant: Layer-Sensitivity Guided Quantization for One-Step Diffusion Real-World Video Super-Resolution
papers.contribution: Achieves nearly full-precision performance with significant speedup and significantly exceeds existing quantization techniques.

papers.title: LaRA-Fusion: Latent-Robust Adaptation via Dual-Loop Constraints for Infrared and Visible Image Fusion
papers.contribution: Extracts topologically aligned features robust to modality-specific variations, outperforming state-of-the-art methods with superior robustness and interpretability through latent-robust adaptation.

papers.title: Large-capacity and Receiver Authenticable Generative Image Steganography
papers.contribution: Achieves superior secure multi-receiver isolation and high-capacity generative image steganography with dynamic multi-image concealment.

papers.title: Learning Domain-Aware Task Prompt Representations for Multi-Domain All-in-One Image Restoration
papers.contribution: First multi-domain all-in-one image restoration method that outperforms SOTA methods while showing strong generalization across domains.

papers.title: Light Up Your Face: A Physically Consistent Dataset and Diffusion Model for Face Fill-Light Enhancement
papers.contribution: FiLitDiff achieves high-fidelity fill lighting at low computational cost while better preserving background illumination compared to state-of-the-art relighting methods.

papers.title: MaMi-HOI: Harmonizing Global Kinematics and Local Geometry for Human-Object Interaction Generation
papers.contribution: Simultaneously achieves natural motion and precise contact while extending generation to long-term tasks with complex trajectories.

papers.title: Mitigating Surgical Data Imbalance with Dual-Prediction Video Diffusion Model
papers.contribution: Synthetic data yields consistent gains of 10-20% over baselines in action recognition, tool detection, and motion prediction across three surgical datasets.

papers.title: MotionGRPO: Overcoming Low Intra-Group Diversity in GRPO-Based Egocentric Motion Recovery
papers.contribution: MotionGRPO achieves state-of-the-art performance in 3D motion recovery from egocentric sensors with improved visual fidelity and addresses the vanishing gradient problem from limited intra-group sample diversity.

papers.title: Point Prompting: Counterfactual Tracking with Video Diffusion Models
papers.contribution: The method outperforms prior zero-shot tracking methods on TAP-Vid and achieves performance competitive with self-supervised models without additional training.

papers.title: Quartet of Diffusions: Structure-Aware Point Cloud Generation through Part and Symmetry Guidance
papers.contribution: Achieves state-of-the-art performance as the first 3D point cloud framework fully integrating and enforcing both symmetry and part priors throughout generation.

papers.title: RGGT: A Generative-Prior-Guided Transformer for Unified Rigid and Non-Rigid Point Cloud Registration
papers.contribution: Achieves sota accuracy on rigid (ModelNet40, 3DMatch, KITTI) and non-rigid (4DMatch) benchmarks within single unified framework, demonstrating multi-scale geometric-semantic capture.

papers.title: Rays as Pixels: Learning A Joint Distribution of Video and Camera Trajectories
papers.contribution: The method enables video generation from images following defined trajectories, novel view synthesis from sparse views without poses, and camera trajectory prediction from raw video.

papers.title: ReFocusEraser: Refocusing for Small Object Removal with Robust Context-Shadow Repair
papers.contribution: Achieves state-of-the-art performance for small object removal across benchmark datasets, outperforming existing methods.

papers.title: Resolving Blind Inverse Problems under Dynamic Range Compression via Structured Forward Operator Modeling
papers.contribution: CaMB-Diff significantly outperforms zero-shot baselines in signal fidelity and physical consistency on low-light enhancement, low-field MRI, and HDR reconstruction.

papers.title: SMD: Multi-view Safety-Critical Driving Video Generation in the Real-world Domain
papers.contribution: Generated videos substantially increase collision rates in stress tests and reduce collision rates when used in training, improving planner robustness.

papers.title: Structure-Aware Riemannian Flow Matching for Registration and Fusion of Hyperspectral and Multispectral Images
papers.contribution: Demonstrates superiority across four datasets with joint registration and fusion handling complex non-rigid deformations through geometry-informed framework.

papers.title: TRACE: Your Diffusion Model is Secretly an Instance Edge Detector
papers.contribution: TRACE achieves +5.1 AP improvement on unsupervised instance segmentation and +1.7 PQ on tag-supervised panoptic segmentation while being 81x faster than per-image diffusion inversion.

papers.title: Text-Aware Image Restoration with Diffusion Models
papers.contribution: Faithfully restores textual regions and achieves new state-of-the-art results on TextZoom, an STISR benchmark.

papers.title: TransNormal: Dense Visual Semantics for Diffusion-based Transparent Object Normal Estimation
papers.contribution: On ClearGrasp reduces mean error by 25.5%; on ClearPose achieves 17.7% error reduction.

papers.title: UniRestorer: Universal Image Restoration via Adaptively Estimating Image Degradation at Proper Granularity
papers.contribution: Outperforms state-of-the-art all-in-one methods by large margins and approaches performance of specific single-task models.

papers.title: VFMF: Dense Forecasting by Generating Foundation Model Features
papers.contribution: Generative flow matching of VFM features enables forecasting from partial observations while preserving information more effectively than regression approaches.

papers.title: WEVSR: Video Diffusion Generators for Real-World Video Super‑Resolution with Wavelet-Enhanced VAE Encoder
papers.contribution: Achieves state-of-the-art performance across multiple VSR benchmarks without modifying the pretrained decoder.

papers.title: What Makes Synthetic Data Effective in Image Segmentation
papers.contribution: SENSE is model-agnostic, compatible with diverse architectures, and substantially enhances segmentation performance on Cityscapes, COCO, and ADE20K.

papers.title: WildActor: Unconstrained Identity-Preserving Video Generation
papers.contribution: Consistently preserves body identity under diverse compositions and large viewpoint transitions on Actor-Bench, surpassing existing methods.

papers.title: Zero-shot Human Pose Estimation using Diffusion-based Inverse solvers
papers.contribution: InPose achieves zero-shot generalization across users by leveraging diffusion priors to infer pose sequences compatible with sparse on-body rotation measurements.

papers.title: gen2seg: Generative Models Enable Generalizable Instance Segmentation
papers.contribution: Gen2seg achieves strong zero-shot generalization to unseen object types and styles, approaching SAM performance on seen objects and exceeding it on fine structures and ambiguous boundaries.

papers.title: iTryOn: Mastering Interactive Video Virtual Try-On with Spatial-Semantic Guidance
papers.contribution: Enables video virtual try-on for interactive scenarios with active human-garment interactions like pulling or unzipping.
